links.comparator_used: Pre-implementation period without the cEFM-aiCDS alert system (pre-post comparison in labor induction patients)
links.outcome: Incidence of tachysystole events and management of tachysystole with decrease or discontinuance of oxytocin
links.effect: No significant difference in number of tachysystole events (p = .626) or in management with oxytocin decrease/discontinuance (p = .603)
links.quote: Phase I found no significant difference in the number of tachysystole events ( p = .626) or management of tachysystole with the decrease or discontinuance of oxytocin after implementation ( p = .603).
